dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why, hello there...?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Hello, I am Katheryne, the receptionist of the Adventurers' Guild. My job is to provide the adventurers with quests and intelligence support.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: This service is available around the clock, so there is no need for concern.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Another Katheryne...

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Another? Hehe, have you ever seen more than one Katheryne at once?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: If not, you have probably seen the same me each time. To meet the demands of the adventurers from all over the world, I use a special tool to teleport myself and work in multiple places simultaneously.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Farewell, Adventurer, and thank you for supporting the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd love to teleport, too!

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Oh dear, you actually believed that?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Sorry, that was a joke. Please don't take it to heart.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: In any case, you probably know how to use the Teleport Waypoints, right?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Claim Adventure Rank Rewards

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Claim Adventure Rank Rewards</color>

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Check Valiant Chronicles information

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Check Valiant Chronicles information</color>

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild, My Lady. Is there something I can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Farewell, My Lady, and thank you for supporting the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Have you any awesome commissions for me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: You've come at just the right time. I have a handbook that the Guild would like to present to veteran adventurers such as yourself.

choices.text: Could it be the Official Teyvat Cookbook?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Unfortunately, it isn't.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: As you can see, this handbook contains information on powerful enemies worth facing.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: If you can make good use of it, I'm sure it will be of great help in your adventures. Of course, you're welcome to come back anytime if you need to check on any relevant information.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: I wish you success in your endeavors!

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: It's up to you whether you wish to take on the challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Ad astra abyssosque, Adventurer. We're thankful for your arrival.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Indeed. We are about to begin a new round of ecological surveys, in fact.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Nonetheless, let me begin by explaining the situation.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Recently, eyewitness reports concerning "Specters" have been increasing at an alarming rate.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: This is usually a very rare sort of elemental creature. As such, there must be some special reason behind their sudden resurgence.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: The Guild's understanding of these creatures is still very lacking, so we are currently mobilizing for an all-hands-on-deck investigation.

choices.text: Is it really such a powerful creature?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Due to the suddenness and strangeness of this event, we know little about the state of these Specters or the amount of danger they pose to people.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Then I accept.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Thank you for accepting this commission. What we need you to do is quite simple, actually. You simply need to travel around Inazuma with your companions and observe the peculiarities of these Specters.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: The form these investigations will take is very similar to the Expeditions you've undertaken in the past. We've already sorted out the various sightings of these Specters.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Here, allow me to show you.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Due to the fact that Specters are elemental creatures, you should get optimal results so long as you follow the elemental guidelines recommended by the Guild when dispatching your companions.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: There will be special commissions in which you will have to go and perform an on-site investigation personally, owing to a lack of good intel. Once you've completed such missions, I will continue to organize the dispatches.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So this is preliminary prep work, then.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Indeed. These commissions would usually be quite tough, but I believe that you will see them done with ease.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: I will update you with new information concerning the Specters every day. You can have faith that I will support you and your companions in any way I can.

choices.text: I think I know where we're going with this...

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Oh? You've done such commissions before? That's great, then.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Thanks for your efforts thus far, Adventurer. We have been able to gather sufficient data concerning these Specters.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Mm-hmm. The observational reports you gathered were very important indeed.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: I believe that you need not worry about Specters threatening the ordinary people going forward. I will organize the intelligence we've gathered and submit them to professional researchers for study.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Ah, and yes, please don't forget to claim your rewards from the Guild!

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Ad astra abyssosque! The Adventurers' Guild thanks you for your services!

choices.text: Some extra rewards would make for a nice thank-you.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Haha, no problem. In that case, be sure to take part in future commissions as well.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: You've come at last. I've been waiting for you, Adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: An—Another Katheryne...

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Another? Hehe, have you ever seen multiple Katherynes in a single location?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: If you haven't, then they were one and the same.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: As the only year-round receptionist in the Adventurers' Guild, I can use a special tool to instantly move between various locations in the world to deal with various important matters...

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: After I help you with your matters here, I need to head over to Fontaine. The adventurers over there are notorious for frugality, so I need to receive them well.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Hmm... You believed me? Sorry, I was joking. Please don't take it seriously.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Also, I thought you knew how to use Teleport Waypoints?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Anyway, I won't bother you with pointless trivia. Come, I'll help you process the work that's needed by the Inazuma Adventurers' Guild.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Once things are processed, you can accept commissions here and also enjoy other benefits.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Ad astra abyssosque, Adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Claim Daily Commission Reward

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: I am sorry, but you have not yet completed enough commissions.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Claim Daily Commission Reward</color>

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Thank you for completing today's commissions. Here is your reward.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: <color=#999999FF>Claim Daily Commission Reward</color>

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: You have already claimed today's reward. Please come back for more commissions tomorrow!
